ticket.title: Unified storage schema ADR + migration 0001: one 3NF, scope-namespaced ~/.cascade/cascade.db for the six legacy fragments
tasks: Today Cascade's daemon state is split across six SQLite fragments directly under ~/.cascade/ (all six verified present on this machine 2026-08-26): tasks.db (crates/cascade-core/src/tasks/migrations.rs:33 open_tasks_db), memory.db (crates/cascade-rag/src/memory/db.rs:44 open_memory_db), events.db (crates/cascade-daemon/src/event_bus.rs:29 DB_NAME), scheduler.db (crates/cascade-daemon/src/supervisor.rs:492), registry.db (crates/cascade-daemon/src/discovery/registry.rs:42, db_files::REGISTRY), and provider-usage.db (crates/cascade-daemon/src/ipc.rs:306).

This ticket delivers the DESIGN artifact the whole epic builds on: an Accepted ADR with the full 3NF ERD, the unified-DB path helper, and the complete unified schema applied as version 1 of a new "unified" MigrationRegistry.

Locked storage decisions it must encode (00-SCOPE.md §Decision 5, 05-FORGE-SPEC.md §Decided 5): single ~/.cascade/cascade.db, WAL mode, daemon single-writer, scope columns (tier, project, repo, app) on every domain table, NULLable by tier.
spec_refs: 00-SCOPE.md §Locked decisions 5 (one database) and §Draft epic map E-P9-A

- This ticket delivers the DESIGN artifact the whole epic builds on: an Accepted ADR with the full 3NF ERD, the unified-DB path helper, and the complete unified schema applied as version 1 of a new "unified" MigrationRegistry.
